import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))

# 1. Income distribution by education level
income_edu_plot = sns.boxplot(data=df, x='Education', y='Income', ax=axes[0, 0], palette='viridis')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Income Distribution by Education Level', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Education Level', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Income ($)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Spending categories comparison
spending_cols = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
spending_means = df[spending_cols].mean()
spending_means.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[0, 1], color=plt.cm.Set3(np.arange(len(spending_cols))))
axes[0, 1].set_title('Average Spending by Product Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Product Category', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Average Amount Spent ($)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 3. Purchase channels distribution
purchase_cols = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases', 'NumDealsPurchases']
purchase_data = df[purchase_cols].sum()
purchase_data.plot(kind='pie', ax=axes[1, 0], autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, 
                   colors=plt.cm.Pastel1(np.arange(len(purchase_cols))), textprops={'fontsize': 10})
axes[1, 0].set_title('Distribution of Purchases by Channel', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('')

# 4. Customer demographics heatmap
# Create age groups
df['Age'] = 2024 - df['Year_Birth']
df['Age_Group'] = pd.cut(df['Age'], bins=[0, 30, 40, 50, 60, 100], 
                         labels=['<30', '30-40', '40-50', '50-60', '60+'])

# Create income groups
df['Income_Group'] = pd.qcut(df['Income'], q=4, labels=['Low', 'Medium-Low', 'Medium-High', 'High'])

# Create pivot table for heatmap
pivot_table = df.pivot_table(values='MntWines', index='Age_Group', columns='Income_Group', aggfunc='mean')
sns.heatmap(pivot_table, annot=True, fmt='.0f', cmap='YlOrRd', ax=axes[1, 1], cbar_kws={'label': 'Avg Wine Spending ($)'})
axes[1, 1].set_title('Average Wine Spending by Age and Income Groups', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Income Group', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Age Group', fontsize=12)

# Adjust layout and save
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
